note: Machine-readable model menu for route_planner.py. Every row records licence, VRAM floor, native audio and a confidence flag. Re-verify prices/VRAM before quoting; community numbers are ranges.

t4_free.compute: Turing sm_75 — no bf16, no FP8/NVFP4

models.name: MiniMax-H3 (hosted API)
models.audio_note: 32 kHz stereo, dialogue in 11 stable languages (no stable Urdu/Hindi)
models.identity: strong (Ref2VA with up to 9 images + audio ref)
models.best_for: hero talking shots, dialogue, 2K delivery, client work

models.name: MiniMax-H3-Base (open weights)
models.vram_note: ~100-128 GB resident BF16; pruned INT8 ~42 GB on 80 GB class; 2x RTX 5090 with layer offload
models.best_for: volume work when API per-second cost dominates; 768P only

models.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B
models.vram_note: ~8 GB in ComfyUI with fp8/offload; ~22-24 GB fp16; T4 cannot run fp8
models.speed_5s: 2-9 min on RTX 4090; slower with offload
models.identity: good via image-to-video with a locked reference still
models.best_for: best free-quality 720p plates when you have 24 GB (Colab Pro L4/A100)

models.name: Wan 2.1 T2V 1.3B
models.vram_note: runs on free Colab T4 with fp16 + cpu offload + VAE tiling
models.identity: weak (text only) — use as plate/draft, not as the hero face
models.best_for: free drafts and B-roll plates on a free T4

models.name: Wan 2.2 T2V/I2V-A14B (MoE)
models.vram_note: 16 GB with GGUF Q4 + offload; 80 GB official fp16
models.best_for: best motion realism per dollar, if you rent a 24 GB card

models.name: HunyuanVideo 1.5
models.vram_note: FP8 + CPU text-encoder offload ~14 GB; FP16 ~24 GB (FP8 not available on T4)
models.identity: best faces among free models (community consensus)
models.best_for: free-tier face close-ups on a 24 GB card

models.name: LTX-2.5
models.licence: LTX-2 Community License (free under 10M USD ARR)
models.vram_note: ~32 GB fp8 / 16 GB NVFP4 on Blackwell; 22B + 12B text encoder
models.best_for: native audio + 4K locally, if you own an RTX 5090/Blackwell class card

models.name: LTX-Video (0.9.x distilled)
models.vram_note: ~12 GB; on T4 use fp16 (bf16 unsupported) — quality may degrade
models.best_for: fast free drafts when Wan feels too slow

models.name: LatentSync 1.5
models.audio_note: consumes your own voice track — Urdu/Hindi is your TTS problem, not the model's
models.vram_note: 8 GB inference; T4 needs the capability patch (sm_75 falls back to fp32 otherwise)
models.identity: keeps the source video's face — perfect for the locked Monarch face
models.confidence: verified from upstream README + T4 community patch report
models.best_for: turning a silent free clip of the Monarch face into a talking shot at 0 cost

models.name: LatentSync 1.6
models.vram_note: 18 GB official; community 16 GB run with UNet CPU offload + per-frame VAE decode
models.identity: source face preserved, sharper mouth detail
models.best_for: final free lipsync once a 24 GB card is available

models.name: MuseTalk
models.vram_note: fits comfortably on 16 GB class cards; realtime-ish
models.identity: source face preserved; slightly softer than LatentSync 1.6
models.best_for: quick free lipsync when LatentSync setup fights the T4

models.name: LivePortrait
models.vram_note: light; drives a still portrait with a performance video
models.best_for: animating an existing Monarch still without generating a whole scene
